# apple_app_custom_product_page_localization_search_keyword (Resource)

Assigns one search keyword to a custom product page localization, so that people who search for it see the custom product page instead of the default one. The keywords come from the app's App Store version; list them with `data.apple_app_search_keywords`. The page is searchable once it is approved and visible. The localization's ID changes with each version of the page, which replaces this resource. Destroying the resource removes the keyword. Import it with `<localization_id>/<keyword_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_app_search_keywords" "en_US" {
  app_id   = data.apple_app.example.id
  platform = "IOS"
  locale   = "en-US"
}

resource "apple_app_custom_product_page_localization_search_keyword" "summer" {
  for_each        = data.apple_app_search_keywords.en_US.ids
  localization_id = apple_app_custom_product_page_localization.en_US.id
  keyword_id      = each.value
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `keyword_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the search keyword.
- `localization_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the custom product page localization, e.g. `apple_app_custom_product_page_localization.en_US.id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_custom_product_page_localization_search_keyword.summer
  identity = {
    localization_id = "1a0e5f2a-938a-400d-935c-7bb7c6b3476a"
    keyword_id      = "c3VtbWVy"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `keyword_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the search keyword.
- `localization_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <localization_id>/<keyword_id>
terraform import apple_app_custom_product_page_localization_search_keyword.summer 1a0e5f2a-938a-400d-935c-7bb7c6b3476a/c3VtbWVy
```
